title: Chipmunk learning loop — swallow all pages over time
thesis: nestgate and ALL the other pages are one self-evolution loop. The chipmunk swallows, works, sings, argues, paints. Over time. Auto lyric. Dialectic. Easel and others. Cell, germline, ploidy of gametes too.

revolving.swallow: one germline page per tick. do not swallow whole. chew.
revolving.note: ALL of these are in the loop. the chipmunk works them over time. not a one-shot.

auto.lyric: form:lyric — verse from the swallow. titles on RSS, full lyric when asked.
auto.dialectic: form:dialectic — thesis × antithesis from the Klein pair. remainder is synthesis.
auto.easel: form:easel — make. pigment from the chew. canvas at easel.html.
auto.others: doc, patent, story, move, game, map, weather, decomp — same mouth, other flesh.

biology.cell_soma: the living pages. mitosis = deploy a copy. HUD, nestgate, journal work every day.
biology.germline: sitemap + RSS. heritable. crawlers inherit the trail, not the honeycomb.

ploidy.haploid: one pair, one RSS item, one verse — a gamete. take it with you.
ploidy.diploid: braid of two pages. enter × exit. the zygote is the collapse face.
ploidy.meiosis: p-sort. halve. recombine. hash. NFT by ZK.
ploidy.mitosis: Pages deploy. the soma copies. the germline stays the score.

biology.gametes: the 1000 Klein pairs ARE the gamete pool. chipmunk draws one per tick.

self_evolution.what: the loop learns by swallowing its own pages. lyric and dialectic are the excretions. easel is the painting of the chew.
self_evolution.not: bury the chipmunk. not a person-face. remainder city.
self_evolution.with: the membrane. arbitrary space. p jurisdiction.
